_about: Wilhelm Gesenius (1786-1842): the Hebrew Grammar in the Kautzsch-Cowley second English edition (Oxford, 1910), and the Hebrew and Chaldee Lexicon in Samuel Prideaux Tregelles's translation (first published 1846-57; Tregelles died 1875); from Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title, edition and imprint read from each scan's title page, 2026-11-03. Added by lane A. No uids minted. US public domain.

gesenius-hebrew-grammar: Gesenius' Hebrew Grammar, as edited and enlarged by E. Kautzsch, 2nd English ed., revised by A. E. Cowley (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1910)
gesenius-lexicon-tregelles: Gesenius's Hebrew and Chaldee Lexicon to the Old Testament Scriptures, tr. Samuel Prideaux Tregelles (London: Samuel Bagster & Sons, undated)

_excluded.geseniushebrewgr00geseuoft: Same 1910 edition, but this copy is the 1946-56 lithographic reprint 'from corrected sheets', so a 1910 printing was used instead
_excluded.gesenius-grammar-1898: Collins-Cowley 1898 translation, superseded by the 1910 second edition

_rights_checked.gesenius-lexicon-tregelles: Undated Bagster & Sons Limited reprint of Tregelles's translation (completed 1857); the translator died 1875 and the reprint adds nothing new, so the text is US public domain
